reviewed_candidates.reason: Re-anchoring requires absolute paths, canonicalizes them, and uses path.relative containment checks that reject sibling-prefix collisions before preserving only the contained relative suffix.

The new resume cwd reaches the Droid process spawn, but it comes from the same persisted summary cwd already accepted for new sessions; the change does not expose a new filesystem privilege or shell interpolation sink.

Worktree-removal preparation uses connected-only sending, correlated request IDs, acknowledgement handling, waiter cleanup, and a bounded timeout, so it cannot be queued and replayed after reconnection.
The authoritative sidecar registry refuses re-anchoring whenever any matching summary is live, independently of renderer-side active-session checks.
All affected summaries are persisted in one history synchronization call before canonical in-memory publication, preventing partial visible migration.

ClientCommand ingress still relies on the existing bridge token and TypeScript-only command dispatch rather than runtime schemas; this change adds no authentication bypass and does not expand privileges beyond existing arbitrary session cwd creation.
